papers.title: The Information in Option Volume for Future Stock Prices
papers.published_mechanism: Buy-to-open put-call ratios predict next-day and next-week stock returns.
papers.data_requirement: Buyer-initiated open-new-position option volume, not total option volume.
papers.our_substitute: Aggregated total put/call volume from Hugging Face; full volume only in limited samples.
papers.restriction: Do not compare our ratio numerically with the paper. Open-buy data are unavailable.
papers.full_text_status: Metadata only; authorized PDF not obtained in this environment.

papers.title: What Does the Individual Option Volatility Smirk Tell Us About Future Equity Returns?
papers.publication: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis 45(3), 641–662
papers.published_mechanism: Steeper individual-option smirks precede weaker equity returns and worse earnings shocks.
published_targets_pending_full_text: 10.9% per year risk-adjusted underperformance of steepest versus least pronounced smirks
papers.data_requirement: Paper-specific individual-option smirk construction and historical universe.
papers.our_substitute: Nearest 25-delta put-minus-call IV on a mid-DTE DoltHub subset and full forward Cboe chains.
papers.restriction: Economic mechanism only; do not target the published 10.9% estimate.
papers.full_text_status: Metadata only; authorized PDF not obtained in this environment.

papers.title: Variance risk premia, asset predictability puzzles, and macroeconomic uncertainty
papers.published_mechanism: Risk-neutral expected variance minus objectively expected variance is priced across asset markets.
papers.data_requirement: Risk-neutral variance and a physical variance forecast; the review discusses multi-lag realized-variance forecasts.
papers.our_substitute: Mid-DTE ATM IV minus trailing 20-session realized volatility, with forward-RV validation.
papers.restriction: Our IV-minus-RV20 feature is not a variance swap or the paper's complete VRP estimator.

papers.title: Earnings Guidance and Market Uncertainty
papers.published_mechanism: Unbundled guidance can increase uncertainty; uncertainty declines after the earnings announcement.
papers.data_requirement: OptionMetrics standardized constant-duration ATM IV, First Call, CRSP and IBES.
papers.our_substitute: Matched traded-option mid-DTE IV around official earnings/filing timestamps.
papers.restriction: We test earnings IV crush, not the paper's guidance effect or standardized 30–730 day IV series.
